name: Chicago Plastic Systems
old_description: Chicago Plastic Systems' greatest asset is it's employees.  Although you've undoubtedly heard that from other companies, our organization was founded with this philosophy from the beginning and holds true today. Most of our employees are hired based on a referral from one of our current employees or business partners. This builds an environment that feels like family and a staff that functions as a team. In addition, because our employees are truly made to feel they're part of something bigger than themselves, they take great pride in every aspect of our business. As a result, our customers get the benefits of increased productivity and superior workmanship.
about:
Chicago Plastic Systems is headquartered in Neenah, Wisconsin, with a second facility in Crystal Lake, Illinois. The company was founded in September 1995 by three businessmen—Dirk Howell, John Stewart, and Leif Heggem—who started in Howell’s garage producing CPVC fittings for the metal finishing industry. The business is veteran-owned.

The company specializes in industrial thermoplastic fabrication, offering plastic machining, plastic welding, custom fabrication of tanks, process skids, pipe systems, ductwork, enclosures, and corrosion-resistant ventilation equipment. Operations span 107,000 square feet across two locations, with a staff of approximately 50 employees. Fabricators are DVS certified or in certification, and the shop includes multiple CNC machines, a large CNC butt welder, and one of the largest brake presses dedicated to plastic bending.

Chicago Plastic Systems serves industries including metal finishing, water treatment, chemical processing, power generation, semiconductor, food, and pharmaceutical manufacturing. Customers range from OEMs needing custom thermoplastic components to plants requiring integrated installation and maintenance of fabricated systems.

The founders established the company on a philosophy of servant leadership, emphasizing dignity, honesty, and trust in relationships with customers, vendors, and employees. The firm highlights its commitment to DVS certification for all fabricators—a distinction it claims is unique in the U.S.—and a team-based culture built on employee referrals and long-tenured staff.
